what: nVent Electric makes electrical connection and protection products: enclosures that house electrical equipment, electrical fastening systems, and thermal management including liquid cooling for data centres.
customers: Data centre builders, industrial plants, utilities, infrastructure contractors and commercial builders.
money: enclosures, cooling and power distribution for electrical equipment
moat: Products specified into electrical installations and data centre designs, where approval and compatibility make substitution awkward once a standard is set.
risks: Data centre spending is now a large share of growth, so a pause there would hurt
Industrial demand outside data centres has been soft
Return on invested capital of about 9% reflects acquisition goodwill
opportunities: Revenue grew about 30% last year and about 19% a year over three years
Analysts see large upside, with a median target well above the current price
Liquid cooling for AI racks is a fast-growing product line where it has a position
watch: Data centre revenue growth and organic order rates.
